lines.text: He founded His city on the holy mountains, and the LORD loves Zion's gates more than all Jacob's dwellings.
Glorious things are ascribed to the city of God.
The LORD says He will mention Rahab and Babylon, along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush, among those who know Him.
It will be said this one and that one were born in Zion, and the sons of Korah will establish her.
The LORD will record in the register that this one was born in Zion, and kings and prophets will proclaim joy.
